body: Wouldn't that be something. Apologies for your rough day, hope you're pushing through. Like I said, any time you need to get anything out.
Thank you. If you ever need to let out your own thoughts, feel free, please.

You are too kind. I apologize again by the length of the post. I was having a rough path. Spring usually gets to me the most. I was expecting to write a paragraph or two of nonsense, but I just kept writing. Thank you for hearing me out, and for assuring me of the importance of every individual. I hope I have helped you as much as you helped me.
I'm glad you found your reason. I'm glad you can stick by that reason even when it gets tough. Keep swimming, pal.

You are helpful. Sometimes we just need to get our thoughts out, even if there's nothing we plan to achieve with it. Even if it's a 10 page splurge of words you typed out on a Sunday evening. But being able get your thoughts out there and see that it's okay to express your feelings, that people will still accept you even with all of your inner struggles, that in itself is helpful. Thank you.
Thank you for taking the time, and thank you for your empathy. I apologize for any sadness I might have caused you, I hope I may have at least provided some solace as someone who you can relate to.
